items.title: At the Library: Listen Up! The Music of The Beatles
items.description: What makes the music of the Beatles so great? Join Quincy resident and music professor Del Case in a 3-part series exploring the brilliance of the Beatles' music. Sessions will be held on September 18th, September 25th and October 2nd at 7pm at the Thomas Crane Library.

items.title: At the Library: Listen Up! Stars of American Music
items.description: Professor Del Case talks about a 3-part series on American music, featuring great artists in jazz, folk and classical genres.  The series will take place on Thursday June 13th, 20th and 27th at 7pm at the Thomas Crane Public Library.
